_comment: Model tier registry -- the single place that decides which models a CI run tests.
Selected at run time via the QEFF_MODEL_TIER env var (all | priority | legacy),
wired to the MODEL_TIER Jenkins parameter. 'all' is the default and tests everything.
Only the priority tier is declared. Legacy is defined by EXCLUSION: any model that
is not matched here is legacy. That direction is deliberate -- onboarding a new model
can never silently drop out of CI, the worst case is it lands in the legacy tier.
To move a model between tiers, edit this file only. No test or Jenkinsfile change.
model_types  primary key. Matched against the 'model_type' field already carried by
test config entries, so new checkpoints of a listed family are picked up
automatically. A NEW family (e.g. qwen3_7) still needs adding here.
markers      for suites whose models are pipelines behind a pytest marker rather than
config entries (diffusers). Must be a subset of model_markers below.
model_names  escape hatch for entries that carry no 'model_type' (grok-1, SwiftKV,
the text-embedding models). Exact Hugging Face card match.
_model_markers_comment: Every pytest marker that identifies a model family rather than a capability.
This is the marker UNIVERSE: a test carrying one of these markers is a model test and
is tiered by marker. Markers also listed under priority.markers are priority; the rest
are legacy. Do not list capability markers (on_qaic, diffusion_models, multimodal...) --
those describe how a test runs, not which model it covers, and listing one would make
every test in that stage tierable.
